title: The Fair Game: Auditing & Debiasing AI Algorithms Over Time

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes a theoretical 'Fair Game' framework that uses Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) auditors and Reinforcement Learning (stochastic games) to dynamically estimate and mitigate observational fairness metrics (e.g., Statistical Parity, Demographic Parity, Equalised Odds) across sensitive demographic features (such as race and gender) over time.
